RIYADH / INTEGRATED BUSINESS DEVELOPMENT & EXECUTION

Methodology

Each stage produces a defined output and remains tied to the approved business objective.

Define the development objective↗
BO
01

Six stages.
One approved objective.

  1. 01

    Assess

    Evaluate the opportunity, organisation, market position, performance, capabilities and risks.

    TYPICAL OUTPUT

    Opportunity, organisational and risk assessment

  2. 02

    Define

    Set priorities, objectives, business requirements and the desired future position.

    TYPICAL OUTPUT

    Defined priorities, objectives and business requirements

  3. 03

    Structure

    Develop the business model, operating model and capability requirements.

    TYPICAL OUTPUT

    Business model, operating model and capability requirements

  4. 04

    Plan

    Create a phased roadmap with resources, responsibilities, milestones and measures.

    TYPICAL OUTPUT

    Phased roadmap, responsibilities, milestones and measures

  5. 05

    Execute

    Coordinate specialist teams and implement approved initiatives.

    TYPICAL OUTPUT

    Coordinated implementation of approved initiatives

  6. 06

    Measure & Develop

    Track performance, identify gaps, refine execution and prepare for growth.

    TYPICAL OUTPUT

    Performance review, identified gaps and development priorities

02

Activity is not achievement.

01

Execution KPIs

Tasks · Time · Budget · Outputs. Did we deliver what we said, when we said it?

02

Business KPIs

Revenue · Leads · Conversion · Retention · Margin. Did the business get commercially stronger?

03

Market KPIs

Share · Visibility · Positioning · Tender wins · Competitor movement. Did the market respond?
